purpose: First extraction run on the five reviewed text-pilot development examples
selection_policy: All five reports in source-file order; no selection by outcome
input_policy: Each stateless request receives only the report text plus the extraction instructions/schema. No seed, gold, questionnaire, or generation conversation is supplied.
postprocessing_policy: Use the existing current deterministic normalizer and report metadata, with empty questionnaire arrays. No reference-assisted repair.
primary_metrics: all 110 predeclared candidate semantic field checks with per-field counts
normalized core field accuracy, separately for known and null reference values
separate_diagnostics: Exact time_text span equality; keep differences visible without treating every wording boundary difference as a semantic extraction error
Quoted evidence must be an exact source substring and support the claimed fields; reference span boundaries need not be identical
whole_report_semantic_pass: Requires successful processing, no missing/extra observations, all candidate checks correct, all normalized core fields correct, matching issue flags, and source-supported evidence. Report exact time_text mismatches separately.
failure_policy: Failed and missing reports remain in the denominators. Do not silently retry, drop cases, or rewrite output.
change_policy: Freeze sources, references, model, prompt, and runtime before requests. No prompt tuning, reference edits, training, or dashboard changes in this run.
limits: Five controlled development reports and ten symptom observations
Same model generated the synthetic text; independent extraction calls do not remove synthetic-style bias
TP003 has a disclosed pre-extraction editorial clarification
TP004 and TP005 are a related report pair, not independent patient samples
No claim about held-out performance or real clinical accuracy
